They do not itemize the interlinear glosses; applying the dedication to them is an inference. The 2026-10-27 release check (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md) found no current rights claim on the interlinear's own pages (interlinearbible.com, which shows a "Free Licensing" link, and the biblehub.com interlinear). Berean also asks that the Berean name not be used for derivative works that vary from the official text.
sources_chirho.attribution_chirho: English glosses from the Berean Interlinear Bible (https://interlinearbible.com), extracted to Nestle 1904 word ids by biblicalhumanities.org (https://github.com/biblicalhumanities/Nestle1904).
